extension.summary: Dense, cinematic cover walls for movies, music and TV in Kodi
extension.description: A cinematic Kodi skin: edge-to-edge animated cover walls for movies, music and TV shows with related-title shuffling, list views, collections (New, Paused, Played and your own), scenes and Demo Scripts, favourites, search, Now Playing, colour themes, and a Home screen with rotating library artwork and live now-playing video. Requires the KScape wall add-on (script.kscape.wall) for the animated wall.
